column1: # THE jupiterOS Arcade console-system catalogue — single source of truth,
# consumed by BOTH sides of the ROM pipeline:
#   * modules/services/arcade-catalogue.nix parses this file into the
#     arcade-inventory / cartridges all derive from it), and
#     COLLECTIONS maps + ROM_RE from the same rows at runtime.
# Adding or removing a system is ONE row here; every consumer follows. (The
# five former hand-copied maps DID drift — an 'acorn' system once existed
# only in rom-acquire and would have promoted to the pool invisible.)
# Scope: the McLean 1G1R collection (Fresh1G1R) integrated into the arcade.
# Systems are included only when nixpkgs ships a libretro core (core column,
# loaded via 'jupiter-retroarch -L <core>'; unfree is fine — allowUnfree is
# set fleet-wide) or a supported standalone emulator (Wii U -> cemu). Arcade
# excluded for now. Obscure systems with no libretro core are excluded.
#   system      dir key + Pegasus shortname (nes, snes, ... 3ds)
#   core        nixpkgs libretro attr name for 'jupiter-retroarch -L <core>'
#   emulator    standalone emulator wrapper when core is "-" (cemu)
#   extensions  ROM file extensions (comma-separated, no dots)
#   sky         Skyscraper -p handle when it differs from 'system'
#   bucket      europa dataset: cartridge | optical | modern
#   torrent     Minerva/Myrient torrent basename for rom-acquire
# Notes: cartridge sets ship as .zip (No-Intro) and cue/bin pairs travel
# together — both live in cartridge-scrape.sh's GLOBAL_EXTS, not per-system.
